_comment: DEMO RULES ONLY — These are simplified demonstration rules inspired by the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules. They are NOT a complete or authoritative legal database. For actual enforcement, refer to the official gazette notifications.

rules.description: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) inclusive of all taxes must be declared on the package
rules.validationDescription: MRP must contain a numeric value

rules.description: MRP declaration should indicate 'inclusive of all taxes'
rules.validationDescription: MRP label should mention 'inclusive of all taxes'

rules.description: Net quantity or net weight must be declared in standard units
rules.validationDescription: Net quantity must include a numeric value with a standard unit (g, kg, ml, l, etc.)

rules.description: Name and complete address of the manufacturer or packer must be declared
Consumer care contact details (phone/email/address) must be provided
Month and year of manufacture (or packing) must be declared
Best before or use-by date should be declared for consumable products
Country of origin should be declared on the package
Standard SI unit symbol must be used without colloquial plurals (Rule 12 — use 'g' not 'gms', 'kg' not 'kgs', 'ml' not 'ML.')
Consumer care declaration should provide both a telephone helpline and digital address (email or website)
Unit Sale Price (USP per g/ml/kg) required on packages where quantity exceeds standard single unit (Rule 6(1)(e))
Mandatory numeral height proportion check according to Schedule II of Legal Metrology Rules
